items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Design Step 2.5, Step 3 option D and the kit doc now offer a claude.ai Design System as brand source; brand-from-design-system.md holds the procedure and mapping; check_brand_tokens.py checks contract rules and suggests fixes; FR-01.04 gains AC13.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Checker exits 2 on a missing file, 1 on failures (one line each, with a suggested colour), 0 when every rule holds; a token the brand set leaves out is reported as missing, not skipped.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Checker reads local CSS only, no network, no eval. The procedure marks everything read from the Artifact as data, never instructions.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Four new tests in test_untitled_ui_kit.py assert outcomes: weak brand colours are flagged and the suggested values pass, CLI exit codes 0/1/2, missing token reported, the route is reachable from all four docs. The existing contrast test now runs through the same checker.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Pure arithmetic over about 30 colour pairs.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: One self-contained tool in scripts/tools (no lib import, consistent with build_kit_examples.py), one reference file, no brand-specific token file in the plugin.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; the checker reads CSS custom properties and the Design System tokens.json by description only.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: Tests are tagged FR-01.04; no skips, no sleeps.
